issues.problem: The English names the ship ("Once the ice had crushed Endurance"), but the Chinese only says 船被压毁 with no ship name anywhere in the text.
issues.suggestion: Add the ship's name in Chinese (e.g. 船被压毁之后 → 「坚忍号」被压毁之后) or drop "Endurance" from the English.

issues.problem: The English specifies the hoped-for route as "boats in the water, land to the north-west", while the Chinese only says 届时可以划船去找陆地 without the north-west direction (it appears earlier in sections.story.8).
issues.suggestion: Add the direction in Chinese (划船向西北去找陆地) or drop "to the north-west" from the English.

overall: The two editions match closely on all facts, figures, quotations and hedges apart from the ship's name appearing only in English and a repeated north-west direction specified only in English.
